en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a coastal town with many low, tile-roofed houses on a hillside leading down to the sea. The foreground shows orderly streets and single- to two-story buildings; the background includes more densely packed houses and a small peninsula. Printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom identify the town as Agios Nikolaos in Crete, and a website watermark appears in the lower right.
